4806.title: Retained ACP permission policy on follow-ups
4806.rootCauseOneLine: Follow-up handling ignores the requested permission mode; reconstruction copies the old mode, retaining stale launch flags and automatic approval policy.
4806.proposedFix: Validate and apply incoming permission mode consistently to the agent launch and live approval policy before the next prompt; requires authorized permission-boundary work, so no autopilot PR.
4806.caveats: Five intended regression failures repeated by the same agent in a second clean checkout. Real Cursor/Codex and composer UI were not exercised. Complete reproduction test is inline; raw artifacts are local only under reports publication policy.
